changed_in.5.4: Takes both of its arguments optionally and hands back the two components of the seed it used, so the same state can be asked for again; called with none it builds a seed at run time from whatever varies. Each argument given must be an integer, or a float sitting exactly on one. Earlier versions require one argument, take any number for it, return nothing, and leave the generator unseeded until this is called — so a program that never calls it repeats one sequence on every run.
